page: Amazon Web Services r8gb.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized server built on 64-bit ARM architecture using AWS Graviton processors. The machine features 96 physical CPU cores operating at a clock speed of 2.8 GHz. Threading is fixed at one thread per physical core, providing 96 dedicated vCPUs with no multi-threading sharing.

System memory totals 768.0 GB, allocating 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Direct bare-metal hardware access avoids hypervisor latency and virtualization overhead. The server includes no local disk storage and features a 200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth speed. No GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are present in this configuration.

The 8.0 GB per-core RAM allocation provides strong memory density for data-heavy workloads. This architecture is suited for in-memory databases, large key-value caches, enterprise analytics, and high-throughput batch data processing.
